## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |

| account | `account` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Snowflake account identifier. |
| warehouse | `warehouse` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Warehouse name. |
| database | `database` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Database name. |
| schema | `schema` | Text | `PUBLIC` |   | The run | Schema name. |
| username | `username` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Username. |
| password | `password` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | Password. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
